title: Google and Kaggle Free AI Agents Vibe Coding Course
highlights: Google and Kaggle have opened registration for the second edition of their free AI Agents Intensive course, running June 15–19, 2026. The curriculum introduces vibe coding — building AI agents using natural language as the primary programming interface — alongside new content on production deployment and a hands-on capstone project. Features daily livestreams and certificates.

title: Agentic AI 2026 - Internshala Competitions
highlights: An upcoming, immersive enterprise training program curated by Google Cloud experts and industry leaders. Running June 9–18, 2026. Focuses on transitioning from text UI to real-time agentic workflows using the Gemini Live API, prompt design for vocal interactions, and building production-grade persistence layers with Firebase Auth and Firestore.

title: Build Agentic Apps Using Claude Code & Bootcamp Info Session
highlights: Scheduled for Friday, July 31, 2026, 4:00 PM UTC. A free virtual session on Maven where attendees learn to assess if an agentic approach is appropriate, design agentic workflows, implement them using Claude Code, and leave with immediate workflow files.

title: Detecting Compromised AI Agents - Google Cloud Community Webinar
highlights: Wednesday, June 10, 2026 (7 AM PT). SecOps Webinar demonstrating how prompt injections can exploit Model Context Protocol (MCP) to compromise cloud infrastructure, and how to build YARA-L rules and SOAR playbooks to stop threats.

title: Anthropic AI Fluency Courses on Coursera
highlights: Anthropic has launched five free AI fluency courses on Coursera (Community Impact courses). Includes general AI fluency framework, human-AI collaboration, generative AI, and specialized courses for educators, students, and nonprofits.
